title: A bill to designate the community-based outpatient clinic of the Department of Veterans Affairs in St. Augustine, Florida, as the "Leo C. Chase Jr. Department of Veterans Affairs Clinic".
official_summary: This bill designates the community-based outpatient clinic of the Department of Veterans Affairs located at 207 Stratton Road, St. Augustine, Florida, as the Leo C. Chase Jr. Department of Veterans Affairs Clinic or the Leo C. Chase Jr. VA Clinic.

summary.headline: A 2020 law renames a VA outpatient clinic in St. Augustine, Florida, after veteran Leo C. Chase Jr.
summary.what_it_does: This law names the Department of Veterans Affairs community-based outpatient clinic at 207 Stratton Road in St. Augustine, Florida, the Leo C. Chase Jr. Department of Veterans Affairs Clinic. It also allows the shorter name, the Leo C. Chase Jr. VA Clinic. The clinic's medical services are not changed by this law.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on October 13, 2020.
